nodes.prompt: The weather forecast shows 90% chance of flash floods next week. Your sugarcane crop worth ₹60,000 is standing in the field. The insurance deadline is TODAY.

options.label: Buy insurance now (₹1,800 premium, 2% of crop value)
Skip insurance, harvest early to save what you can
Do nothing and hope the forecast is wrong

nodes.prompt: The floods came. Insurance paid ₹48,000 (80% of crop value). You only paid ₹1,800!
nodes.lesson: [Skill Tested: Insurance Literacy] Under PMFBY, farmers pay just 1.5-2% premium. The government subsidises the rest. ₹1,800 protected a ₹60,000 crop — a 33x return on protection!

nodes.prompt: You harvested early and got ₹25,000 — only 42% of the potential value due to immature crop.
nodes.lesson: [Skill Tested: Insurance Literacy] Early harvesting due to panic often results in lower quality and price. Insurance allows you to wait for optimal harvest timing without fear.

nodes.prompt: The floods destroyed 95% of your crop. With no insurance, you lost ₹57,000 and still owe harvest loans.
nodes.lesson: [Skill Tested: Insurance Literacy] One uninsured flood can wipe out years of savings. PMFBY enrolment is now linked to Kisan Credit Cards — always enrol before the deadline.
